description_en: Creates an account that is granted read-only permissions for shard nodes in an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance that uses cloud disks
description_zh: 创建MongoDB云盘版分片集群实例的Shard只读账号
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-account --db-instance-id dds-uf6e9433e955xxxx --account-name admin1 --account-password 'Test123456!' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account. The name must be 4 to 16 characters in length. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a lowercase letter. The account is granted read-only permissions
parameters.help_zh: 账号名。由小写字母、数字或下划线组成，以小写字母开头，长度为4~16个字符。权限为只读
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the database account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. It can contain at least three types of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include ! # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =
parameters.help_zh:
账户密码。
大写、小写、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为8~32个字符；特殊字符为 ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

特殊字符的处理方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account that you want to create. Valid values:

db (default): shard account (available)

cs: ConfigServer account

normal: replica set account

You can set this parameter only to db
parameters.help_zh:
创建账号类型。取值：
db: 默认值，shard账号（仅支持）
cs：config server账号
normal：副本集账号

当前仅支持创建DB账号
parameters.name: character_type
